hook_text: Nothing is pushing a moving box forward. Nothing. And it keeps moving.
clip_script: A force is a push or a pull — always an interaction between two objects. Every arrow on your page must have a second object answerable for it. No responsible object, no force. Four forces, four responsible objects: Earth, floor, strap, rough surface. Notice what is absent: no force of motion, no force of momentum. Motion is not an object and pushes nothing — smuggling it onto the diagram is the oldest error in mechanics.
visual_style: A box gliding across the screen while a ghost arrow labelled 'force of motion' is stamped out in red, and the four real arrows click onto a clean dot one by one.
pacing: Bold hook, rapid arrow reveals, hard-stop rule at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the 25-degree strap problem yourself.
